title: Updates to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) for Admins in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) adds a workspace for admins to configure organizational data and context, improving AI-driven responses. Rolling out mid-November 2026 for Frontier tenants, it requires specific admin roles and licensing, with controls for data access, configuration, and compliance.
body:
[What and why]

We are adding new capabilities to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) in Microsoft 365 Copilot, enabling organizations to get grounded and contextually relevant responses in Copilot from their organizational data. The agent now provides administrators with an additional dedicated workspace to configure organizational definitions, data descriptions and business context. In the agent, admins can also validate how AI reason over those contexts in people and organizational queries and ask the agent to help diagnose gaps or issues where the responses are different than expected.

As the changes rolling out, configurations applied in Workforce Insights Agent will start to apply across some Copilot experiences, with the plan to extend availability across all Copilot experiences in the future. Review the Workforce Insights Agent roadmap and documentation for more details.

[Rollout schedule]

- Public Preview (Frontier): Beginning in mid-November 2026, the new capabilities will become available to all Frontier tenants[Impact on Your Organization]

Who is affected

- Tenants: Tenants with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses or the Microsoft 365 Copilot in Productivity Apps service plan, and enrolled in Frontier program, will see the agent available in the agent store- Administrator roles: Global, AI and Organizational Data Administrators will be needed for configurationsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft 365 Copilot, Workforce Insights Agent, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, and People SkillsWhat will happen

- By default, licensed users can discover and install Workforce Insights Agent through Copilot or the Teams agent store, subject to admin policies. This does not grant access to configuration controls or data/expanded scope queries beyond users' existing permissions.- AI administrators manage agent deployment and access, while Organizational Data Administrators can configure organizational context and validate results directly in the Workforce Insights Agent. We recommend assigning Organizational Data Administrator to individuals responsible for providing and maintaining data and organizational context, such as HR or People Analytics teams.- Workforce Insights Agent uses organizational data from Microsoft Entra ID by default. Organizations can use Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service in Microsoft 365 Admin Center for additional attributes. Configuring context in the agent does not modify data in the underlying source system.- In Workforce Insights Agent, administrators can configure organizational context and attribute descriptions to help the agent and soon Copilot better understand how data should be interpreted or metrics should be calculated for your organization. Descriptions explain what each attribute represents, including relevant values, abbreviations, and guidance for its use. With this release, these capabilities apply fully to Workforce Insights Agent and to some types of queries in other Copilot experiences. Check out the Workforce Insights documentation and roadmap for more details and latest updates.• AI Administrators and Organizational Data Administrators should review deployment scope and configuration for the intended audience.

[Action Required / Recommendations]

Before enabling or expanding use:

- Review licensing and access: Ensure intended users have the required Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and the tenant has enrolled in Frontier program. Review default discovery and installation. Admins can install the agent for users, restrict access to users or groups, or remove or block it.- Prepare data and organizational context: Review Entra ID data quality, reporting relationships, organizational attributes, definitions, and terminology. Additional or replacement data can be provided through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. Review permissions and data-handling requirements before uploading. Add organizational context from your existed business collateral to the agent and leverage the interactive tuning experience as appropriate.- Review configuration: Admin configurations will move from the Workforce Insights Admin web page to Workforce Insights Agent home page. Supported options include attribute descriptions, organizational context and visibility to all configurations such as attributes & access policies, data access and more.- Consider People Skills: Enable People Skills if skills-based queries are required and review its setup and governance requirements.- Review data access: Users can request expanded data scope from people with direct reports. Use the WorkforceInsights PowerShell module to control this access according to organizational policies.- Validate results: Have authorized users test representative prompts against known data and definitions, address discrepancies, and repeat validation after changes.Learn more 

- Workforce Insights Agent- Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service- People Skills overview- Workforce Insights[Compliance considerations]

Workforce Insights Agent is not designed for behavioral monitoring, performance management or employment decisions. Administrators are responsible for local legal and business requirements, data protection obligations and Works Council guidelines. Configure available controls to align with these requirements and business practices.

Compliance considerationExplanationStores new customer dataUses organizational data from Microsoft Entra and optionally additional data uploaded through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.Alters processing of existing customer dataProcesses organizational data to generate workforce insights such as structure, roles, and composition.Introduces AI/ML capabilities interacting with customer dataUses AI to analyze organizational and skills data and generate insights through natural language queries.Admin control available (Entra groups)Admins can control access, restrict deployment, and manage availability using Microsoft 365 admin center and Entra group-based controls.User can enable/disable featureUsers can install and pin the agent themselves unless restricted by administrative policies.
bodyHtml:
[What and why]

We are adding new capabilities to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) in Microsoft 365 Copilot, enabling organizations to get grounded and contextually relevant responses in Copilot from their organizational data. The agent now provides administrators with an additional dedicated workspace to configure organizational definitions, data descriptions and business context. In the agent, admins can also validate how AI reason over those contexts in people and organizational queries and ask the agent to help diagnose gaps or issues where the responses are different than expected.

As the changes rolling out, configurations applied in Workforce Insights Agent will start to apply across some Copilot experiences, with the plan to extend availability across all Copilot experiences in the future. Review the Workforce Insights Agent roadmap and documentation for more details.

[Rollout schedule]

  • Public Preview (Frontier): Beginning in mid-November 2026, the new capabilities will become available to all Frontier tenants

[Impact on Your Organization]

Who is affected

  • Tenants: Tenants with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses or the Microsoft 365 Copilot in Productivity Apps service plan, and enrolled in Frontier program, will see the agent available in the agent store
  • Administrator roles: Global, AI and Organizational Data Administrators will be needed for configurations

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot, Workforce Insights Agent, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service, and People Skills

What will happen

  • By default, licensed users can discover and install Workforce Insights Agent through Copilot or the Teams agent store, subject to admin policies. This does not grant access to configuration controls or data/expanded scope queries beyond users' existing permissions.
  • AI administrators manage agent deployment and access, while Organizational Data Administrators can configure organizational context and validate results directly in the Workforce Insights Agent. We recommend assigning Organizational Data Administrator to individuals responsible for providing and maintaining data and organizational context, such as HR or People Analytics teams.
  • Workforce Insights Agent uses organizational data from Microsoft Entra ID by default. Organizations can use Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service in Microsoft 365 Admin Center for additional attributes. Configuring context in the agent does not modify data in the underlying source system.
  • In Workforce Insights Agent, administrators can configure organizational context and attribute descriptions to help the agent and soon Copilot better understand how data should be interpreted or metrics should be calculated for your organization. Descriptions explain what each attribute represents, including relevant values, abbreviations, and guidance for its use. With this release, these capabilities apply fully to Workforce Insights Agent and to some types of queries in other Copilot experiences. Check out the Workforce Insights documentation and roadmap for more details and latest updates.

• AI Administrators and Organizational Data Administrators should review deployment scope and configuration for the intended audience.

[Action Required / Recommendations]

Before enabling or expanding use:

  • Review licensing and access: Ensure intended users have the required Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and the tenant has enrolled in Frontier program. Review default discovery and installation. Admins can install the agent for users, restrict access to users or groups, or remove or block it.
  • Prepare data and organizational context: Review Entra ID data quality, reporting relationships, organizational attributes, definitions, and terminology. Additional or replacement data can be provided through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service. Review permissions and data-handling requirements before uploading. Add organizational context from your existed business collateral to the agent and leverage the interactive tuning experience as appropriate.
  • Review configuration: Admin configurations will move from the Workforce Insights Admin web page to Workforce Insights Agent home page. Supported options include attribute descriptions, organizational context and visibility to all configurations such as attributes & access policies, data access and more.
  • Consider People Skills: Enable People Skills if skills-based queries are required and review its setup and governance requirements.
  • Review data access: Users can request expanded data scope from people with direct reports. Use the WorkforceInsights PowerShell module to control this access according to organizational policies.
  • Validate results: Have authorized users test representative prompts against known data and definitions, address discrepancies, and repeat validation after changes.

Learn more 

  • Workforce Insights Agent
  • Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service
  • People Skills overview
  • Workforce Insights

[Compliance considerations]

Workforce Insights Agent is not designed for behavioral monitoring, performance management or employment decisions. Administrators are responsible for local legal and business requirements, data protection obligations and Works Council guidelines. Configure available controls to align with these requirements and business practices.

Stores new customer dataUses organizational data from Microsoft Entra and optionally additional data uploaded through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.
Alters processing of existing customer dataProcesses organizational data to generate workforce insights such as structure, roles, and composition.
Introduces AI/ML capabilities interacting with customer dataUses AI to analyze organizational and skills data and generate insights through natural language queries.
